_comment: Proportional GUI texture remaps (ref-relative, so any pack resolution works). A 'move' crops a region [x,y,w,h] in ref coords, heals the vacated spot with the local background colour, and pastes it at [dstX,dstY]. A 'copy' does the same without healing, duplicating a region — for a slot modern added where 1.8.9 has bare panel. Every offset here is derived by cross-correlating vanilla 1.8.9 against modern vanilla, not estimated by eye.

textures/gui/container/inventory.png._why: The 2x2 crafting grid + arrow + result moved (-10,+8) between 1.8.9 and modern; shift it so it lines up with the functional slots.

textures/gui/container/brewing_stand.png._why: 1.9 redesigned brewing. The three potion slots moved DOWN 5px — cross-correlated over the slot cluster, best match (0,+5), SAD 196608 -> 32226 — while the ingredient slot above them did not move, confirmed at (0,0) by the same measurement. 1.9 also added a blaze-powder fuel slot at (16,16) where 1.8.9 has bare panel, so the pack's own empty ingredient slot at (78,16) is copied there; that keeps the box in the pack's style instead of leaving a functional slot with nothing drawn behind it. Reported from in-game testing as the potion boxes being slightly off on every pack.
